features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.desc: When you cast a spell of level 1+, the DM can have you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table (a random effect).

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.desc: Once per Long Rest, you can give yourself Advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw; regained when a Wild Magic Surge occurs.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.desc: As a Reaction (2 Sorcery Points), you add or subtract 1d4 to any creature's attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.desc: When a Wild Magic Surge occurs, you roll on the table twice and choose the result.

features.name: Spell Bombardment
features.desc: Once per turn, when you roll the maximum on a spell's damage die, you roll one more such die and add it.
